title: Makers market call for vendors
brief:
Draft a public call for vendors to post at the Cedar Loom Arts Center. Its indoor makers market will run November 21 from 10 a.m. to 3 p.m. Twelve tables are available for local makers selling their own ceramics, prints, textiles, or paper goods. Table fee: $15, payable after confirmation. Applicants can collect and return a paper form at the reception desk by 5 p.m. October 30. If eligible applications exceed capacity, the center will draw names at random and contact applicants by November 4. The notice should give first-time sellers enough information to decide whether to apply.

Aim for 70 to 150 words. Return the complete original work directly in your answer. Do not sign or identify yourself. Do not use tools.

**Call for Vendors at Cedar Loom Arts Center**

Cedar Loom Arts Center invites local makers to sell their work at its indoor makers market on November 21 from 10 a.m. to 3 p.m. If you make your own ceramics, prints, textiles, or paper goods, you can apply for one of 12 tables. First-time sellers are welcome.

Pick up a paper application at the center’s reception desk and return the completed form there by 5 p.m. on October 30.

If more than 12 eligible makers apply, the center will draw names at random. The center will contact applicants by November 4. The fee is $15 per table, payable after your table is confirmed.

fc0a4bc0a684b41a.text:
# Call for Vendors: Cedar Loom Indoor Makers Market

**Saturday, November 21 · 10 a.m. to 3 p.m. · Cedar Loom Arts Center**

We have twelve tables for local makers selling their own ceramics, prints, textiles, or paper goods. First-time sellers are welcome.

**How to apply**

1. Pick up a paper application form at the reception desk.
2. Return it to the reception desk by 5 p.m. on October 30.

**What happens next**

We will contact every applicant by November 4. If we receive more eligible applications than we have tables, we will draw names at random.

**Cost**

The table fee is $15. You pay only after your table is confirmed, and applying is free.

Questions? Ask at the reception desk.
